title: Timeline
idea: Brief #30. Swipe of the docrob.holistic reel (28k likes, 4.8k comments, Aug 2026): an authority puts a castor oil pack on and asks "What would happen if you put castor oil on your ___ every night for 30 nights?", then 5 quick results, how-to, what to look for, CTA. We swap his neck/thyroid/detox for BELLY + BLOATING (our proven angle: #294, #295, #303, #305, #329, Skeleton) and make it a female doctor rolling our oil on and wrapping a female patient, so women 45+ see themselves on the table. Authority-on-bloating is already proven by #319 (doctor, launched) and #243 (doctor, scaling). One hook.

editing_notes:
THE HOOK IS THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THIS AD. The first frame and first line must stop the scroll and make the problem obvious with the sound off. Spend the most time here, and redo it until it's undeniable.
Replicate this format: Reference (link above: docrob.holistic reel, 42 s, 28,267 likes and 4,836 comments since 2026-08-13). Same SCRIPT structure, order and pacing: "What would happen if you put castor oil on your ___ every night for 30 nights?" → 5 quick results → "Here's how you do it" → how to apply → "Make sure you get a ___ castor oil" (label close-ups with a red circle) → one safety line → CTA. Every shot has a reference timestamp in its Visual cell: copy that frame's framing, gesture and caption style.
THE ONE CHANGE TO THE FORMAT: he does it on himself; ours is a FEMALE DOCTOR doing it ON A FEMALE PATIENT. The doctor speaks the script word for word to camera while she rolls the oil onto the patient's belly and wraps the pack on her; the results lines show the patient's life at home. The hook opens on a slight hyperlapse of the doctor rolling it on and wrapping the pack (see the Hook row).
WHAT WE CHANGED (the angle): his neck / thyroid / detox becomes BELLY + BLOATING, and his castor oil pad around the neck becomes OUR cotton belly wrap around her waist. Thyroid, detox, toxins, brain fog, mood, hair and nails are all gone (disease + detox claims). Every result is a bloating result taken from our winner #294.
EVERY APPLICATION SHOT = OUR METHOD: where he pours a tablespoon onto a pad, the doctor rolls the oil onto the patient's belly with the rose quartz roller, then straps the cotton wrap on over it. Never pour, never a dropper.
GENJUTSU: make the doctor's to-camera shots in Genjutsu from the reference clips at the same timestamps (motion + lip-sync reference). The hands-on shots (rolling, wrapping) and the patient's at-home shots = Ai from the reference frames' framing, with our real product photos for the bottle and wrap. Same two women in every shot (make them once, reuse).
B-ROLL: about 80% A-roll (the doctor to camera with her patient, like the reference's talking head) plus the reference's own inserts (kitchen, photo cards, label close-ups, red X, CTA sticker). Every shot copies the reference frame at the timestamp in its Visual cell; our real product photos (Products tab) for the bottle and wrap.
CAPTIONS: copy the reference: bold white CAPS, 2 lines, dark shadow box, key words coloured like the reference (green = the good result, red = the problem, yellow = the body part). How-to and spec lines use the reference's green bar captions (ref 0:20-0:35).
PROOF BEHIND THIS AD: the reference (organic, 28k likes, authority + castor oil wrap). Angle = our bloating winners #294, #295, #303, #305, #329 and Skeleton. Authority on bloating = #319 (Pod 1 doctor, launched) and #243 (doctor, scaling).
CLARITY: one shot per line, showing exactly what's said, at the reference's pacing. No extra fast inserts.
CLAIMS: results are look/feel only: no detox, digestion, weight loss or thyroid.
ALL PEOPLE ARE WHITE (Caucasian).
OFFER: 50% off plus a free bottle (the site pop-up) + 30-day money-back guarantee. No fake deadline. Landing page: Bloating.
Doc: Briefs for HS, tab "#30 authority visual + script" (Brief #30).

Voiceover: The doctor's own voice to camera, American, 55 to 60, warm, certain, a little playful (the ref 0:18 thumbs-down grin). Short lines, a beat after each, same pace as the reference (about 42 s). NEEDS TO HAVE CONVICTION in their voice, its boring to listen to a dull script. They need to speak with character.

Avatar: Avatar 1, THE DOCTOR (speaks every line): WHITE (Caucasian) woman, 55 to 60, glasses, hair pulled back, warm and certain. White doctor's coat over scrubs, blue nitrile gloves the whole video (the reference's gloves). Set: a bright, real-looking treatment room with a padded exam table, plus her consult desk with a wood-slat wall behind it (ref 0:04-0:09's backdrop). No name, no "Dr." sign or badge on screen, and she never states a title: the coat, gloves and the hands-on treatment carry the authority (an unverifiable credential is a rejection risk).
Avatar 2, THE PATIENT (no lines): WHITE (Caucasian) woman, 45 to 55, normal real body with a soft, slightly bloated belly (not extreme; Jared's #294 note: "dial back her stomach"). On the table she wears a fitted tank pulled up and leggings so her belly is bare; at home she's in jeans and a tee. She's the viewer: relaxed, a bit skeptical at first, smiling by the end.
